intent: Add a bounded Rust reference orchestrator around Gmsh and Elmer for a canonical copper-bar analytic benchmark across three meshes. It must fail closed on malformed or missing evidence, retain exact input, output, log, and hash identity, and never imply PCB thermal qualification.

learnings.title: MMS proves solver correctness only for its narrow manufactured case
learnings.note: The new documentation correctly limits this bar benchmark to reference setup.

learnings.title: External FEM corroboration is a validity proxy
learnings.note: The new documentation correctly avoids treating reference_pass as PCB thermal qualification.

residual_risks: The final native Gmsh and Elmer rerun was still active when this report was finalized, so no fresh native-run receipt was available for this review artifact.
testing_gaps: No committed integration fixture executes run() through the complete live Gmsh and Elmer process chain and asserts the emitted identity and artifact inventories.

coverage.cross_model: Cross-model pass not run: path filtering could not exclude unrelated dirty PCB, power-entry, and validation scope; the adversarial lens used the in-process fallback.
scope_notes: Scoped untracked and gitignored thermal files were explicitly included by caller instruction.
Runtime solver binaries and versions were reviewed as recorded evidence, not as a hard allowlist, because this benchmark validates new installations.
No plan was discovered; settlement suppression was not evaluated.

verdicts.reason: Git identity probes now use the timeout-aware process helper.
Every post-directory failure now finalizes report.json with failure state and partial evidence.
Malformed nonblank scalar-name rows are now rejected.
The CLI supplies bundled fixtures and reference_pass rejects changed canonical deck bytes.
Required fixture and retained evidence logs are staged with scoped gitignore exceptions.
Timeout handling kills the Unix process group and a descendant-writer regression test covers it.

tests: Clean staged-index snapshot: all 15 zapote-thermal tests passed.
Full workspace validation: all 335 tests passed.
Final native Gmsh and Elmer rerun was pending at report time.
